name: enginehost
title: Engine host (SDK synth engines on drwave)
summary: Lets several SDK synth engines share TE's drwave engine: a drwave sound whose knob slots 5-8 carry an engine tag is rendered by that engine (WHEEL, WARP, ...), every other drwave sound by TE. Library feature: engines depend on it and register from their init.

evidence.what: device: WHEEL (tag 5) + WARP (tag 6) on the host (image 335770d7; user: 'works great')
